description: We are tackling the Harmonization of MODIS and VIIRS Hot Spots challenge by building an instrument-aware calibration pipeline in Python. Using spatial binning (scan × track optical geometry), orbital de-duplication, and Gradient Boosting with Duan’s smearing estimator, we eliminate the 2012 sensor transition bias to deliver a robust 26-year fire activity time series (2000–2026) across Chile.
